preserved_H4.reason: The supplied 20250114 fixture serializes unnamed pins as ~; the existing public model has no name selector for those pins. The original H4 requirement and failure are retained, not relabelled as passed.

N1.meaning: Numbered alternative after the preserved H4 nameless-marker refusal: disconnect R11 physical pin 1; shared R21.1 follows. Pin 2 remains NC and protected.

M1.meaning: Separate real-name alias test: connect U1 IN+ to /OUT. The exact name matches physical pins 3 and 5 across units 1 and 2; both must be disclosed before confirmation.

M2.meaning: Disconnect U1 real-name alias IN+; both physical pins 3/5 return to their original NC nets, then sync.

constraints: No source/PCB identity, rules, original copper or original final network intent is relaxed. N1 is reported separately from H4. M1/M2 are additional frozen edits using an actual repeated name, not added product capabilities.
